summary: Two churches (Richfield Springs and West Winfield) share one weekly Mass table that is stable across all five bulletins. Weekday-after-Mass Confessions use R10 times, and First Friday/First Saturday services come from the Sept 27 bulletin plus the parish website. Open: whether the 30-minute pre-Mass Adoration applies at Richfield Springs and at West Winfield.
